question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 guide is $108B±2%. NVIDIA has beaten the top of its range 12 straight quarters (Q1 +4.6%, Q2 +5.7% over the midpoint), so Q3 actual is likely ~$113-114B. The last three next-quarter guides were 11.5-14.5% above the prior quarter's actual (68.1->78, 81.6->91, 96.2->108), and guide-over-guide growth was +17-19%; both methods give ~$126-129B. FY27 consensus (~$411B) implies a street Q4 of ~$124.5B, and NVIDIA has recently guided above the street. Management said hyperscale growth 'reaccelerates in Q4' on Vera Rubin supply, which tilts up; memory, power and Rubin supply limits and the Q4 gross-margin trough of 71-72% cap the step. Escape tails: an export or capex shock (below), China inclusion or a faster supply release (above). Live web tools failed this run (API errors), so evidence comes from the repo's Oct 7-9 2026 research traces; those traces found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market on the revenue guide, and the harness search found none either.
